note: USACE Marion Reservoir campground off US 56 between Marion and Hillsboro: 51 electric sites (30-amp; water at most) on two gravel loops either side of a cove, the north point's row and the east loop's shoreline row backing onto the lake; group area with shelter, boat ramp, showers. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API read today: 51 individual sites + group, all 30-amp (stored 50 A was the RIDB catalog's, now superseded), max length 50 (not 70), fees $16-21 for 2026-27, 14 nights in rolling 30, some FCFS. Lakefront confirmed (rec.gov per-site 'Lakefront' + imagery). Pin is in the cove water; proposed move.
flags: HOOKUPS electric 50 -> 30: the live rec.gov per-site API (2026-11-06) gives 'Electricity Hookup: 30' at all 52 campsites; the RIDB catalog cached 2026-10-20 (source of the derived 50) listed 7 at 50 A and a MANAGEMENT site. Current rec.gov outranks the cache (AWH rule). recgov_hookups.py may re-derive 50 from the stale cache unless the cache is refreshed.

SITES count 53 -> 51 (rec.gov description '51 individual sites and one group camping area'; the 53 counted the group site and the host site); max_rig_ft 70 -> 50 (the 70 is the host/management site; the longest public site is 50).
FEES 17-21 -> 16-21: off-peak (Nov-Mar) electric-only sites are $16 per the rate table and per-site prices.

WATERFRONT lakefront confirmed: rec.gov tags 24 sites 'Lakefront'. On Esri imagery the north point's row (014-019) backs onto the shore with only a ~10-15 m fringe of shoreline trees and no road between, and the east loop's 044-051 pads end ~5-15 m from the water behind a thin tree line with gaps; the description says 'known for water front camping sites'. 6,200-acre reservoir.

PIN MOVE: stored 38.3639,-97.1018 sits in the cove's water between the two loops (the sites' centroid falls there too). Proposed 38.3632,-97.1000 (middle of the east loop, ~170 m from the stored pin); the north loop at 38.3655,-97.1040 is the alternative.

PHONE 620-382-2101 confirmed (rec.gov). WEBSITE https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233512 as stored. Military discount rule present on rec.gov (not written; discounts group not part of this check). SAND: none.
